significance: The main temple of Joshimath, seat of the uttaramnaya matha founded by Adi Shankara, whose Narasimha idol is traditionally held to have been installed by the acharya himself. It is revered among the 108 Vishnu shrines sung by the Tamil Alvar saints.
story: The idol's left wrist grows ever thinner; when it finally breaks, the Nar and Narayan mountains are to merge and Badrinath will reappear as a black stone at Bhavishya Badri.
